# City Unscripted

> City Unscripted offers personalized, private walking tours with local hosts across major cities worldwide, specializing in flexible itineraries, food experiences, and cultural immersion.

The platform connects travelers with local guides for customized experiences in destinations spanning Europe, Asia, and Australia. Tours range from half-day city introductions to full-day explorations, food crawls, and specialized cultural experiences like sake tastings, ruin bars, and LGBTQ history tours.

## Key Topics

- Personalized experiences
- Private tours
- Local hosts and guides
- Flexible itineraries
- Food and drink tours
- Walking tours
- Half-day and full-day experiences
- Wine and sake tasting
- Day trips and shore excursions
- Cultural immersion
- City sightseeing
- Neighborhood exploration
- First-time visitor orientations
- Layover and cruise tours

## Full-Day City Experiences

- [The Best Istanbul Private Tour](https://www.cityunscripted.com/turkey/istanbul-tours/full-day-personalized-experience-in-istanbul): Full-day private Istanbul tour with local guide covering highlights & gems
- [The Best Stockholm Private Tour](https://www.cityunscripted.com/sweden/stockholm-tours/full-day-personalized-experience-in-stockholm): Full-day personalized Stockholm tour with fika and local host

- [The Best Kobe Half-Day Tour](https://www.cityunscripted.com/japan/kobe-tours/half-day-personalized-experience-in-kobe): Half-day private Kobe tour with local guide and flexible itinerary

## Food & Drink Experiences

- [Ultimate Sydney Food Tour](https://www.cityunscripted.com/australia/sydney-tours/food-experience-in-sydney): Private Sydney food tour exploring cafes, wine bars & Paddy's Markets
- [Tortellini, Trattorias & Tastes of Bologna](https://www.cityunscripted.com/italy/bologna-tours/food-experience-in-bologna): 3-hour Bologna food tour sampling pasta, Lambrusco at Quadrilatero Market
- [Best Food Tour of Navigli | Milan](https://www.cityunscripted.com/italy/milan-tours/aperitivo-in-navigli-experience-in-milan): 3-hour Navigli aperitivo tour exploring Milanese food & wine tradition
- [London Chinatown Private & Personalized Food Tour](https://www.cityunscripted.com/united-kingdom/london-tours/chinatown-food-crawl): Private London Chinatown food tour exploring Asian cuisine in Soho
- [Prague Private Beer Tour](https://www.cityunscripted.com/czech-republic/prague-tours/czech-beer-experience-in-prague): Private Prague beer tour visiting microbreweries & tasting Czech beers
- [Private Tour of Budapest's Ruin Bars](https://www.cityunscripted.com/hungary/budapest-tours/ruin-bars-experience-in-budapest): 3-hour private ruin bar tour in Budapest's Jewish Quarter
- [Discover the Craft and Culture of Sake in Tokyo](https://www.cityunscripted.com/japan/tokyo-tours/sake-experience-in-tokyo): Tokyo sake tasting tour visiting unique bars in Shibuya with local guide
- [Sapporo Private Sake Tour](https://www.cityunscripted.com/japan/sapporo-tours/hokkaido-sake-experience-in-sapporo): Private Hokkaido sake tasting tour visiting izakaya and sake shops
